title: [docdb][test] Timeout SEGVs across many tests in WaitUntilIndexPermissionIsAtLeast
body:
Ran an analysis over the last 70 or so builds, searching for SEGVs

> cat segv_all_errors | xargs grep -l 'WaitUntilIndexPermissionIsAtLeast' | wc -l
>     259

Seems like these are all timeout related.
